[{"id": "par0001sol", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Embedded maintains the ERP (two named maintainers, plus the Captain's backup admin login).
Daily (automatic): backups stored off the server; failure alerts. Monthly: minor updates after a backup; confirm backups run. Each term: offboard members who left; review roles; equipment walk-through. Each summer: maintainer handover; test restoring a backup; update the README; check the support table; review hosting cost. Start of each car: set up the new car (Car > Actions > Set Up This Car). About every 2 years: major version upgrade, staging copy first. See the README in the team GitHub repo.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "sho0030sol", "type": "shortcut", "data": {"shortcut_name": "User", "col": 3}}, {"id": "sho0031sol", "type": "shortcut", "data": {"shortcut_name": "Solar Settings", "col": 3}}, {"id": "sho0032sol", "type": "shortcut", "data": {"shortcut_name": "Error Log", "col": 3}}, {"id": "car0050sol", "type": "card", "data": {"card_name": "Maintenance", "col": 4}}]
